mapper.insert: insert into lxy_order(order_no, product_id, sell_uid, buy_uid, created_at, `condition`, status, total_amount, pay_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{productId}, #{sellUid}, #{buyUid}, IFNULL(#{createdAt}, NOW()), #{condition}, #{status}, #{totalAmount}, #{payTime})
mapper.select: select status from lxy_order where id = #{id}

SELECT s.id,s.productName,s.sellerName,b.buyerName,s.createdAt,s.`condition` FROM (select o.id AS id,p.`name` AS productName,u.username AS sellerName,o.created_at AS createdAt,o.`condition` AS `condition` from lxy_order o join lxy_product p join lxy_user u where o.sell_uid=u.id and o.product_id=p.id) s JOIN (select o.id AS id,p.`name` AS productName,u.username AS buyerName,o.created_at AS createdAt,o.`condition` AS `condition` from lxy_order o join lxy_product p join lxy_user u where o.buy_uid=u.id and o.product_id=p.id) b WHERE s.id=b.id

select o.id as id, p.name as productName, s.username as sellerName, b.username as buyerName, o.created_at as createdAt, o.`condition` as `condition`, o.status as status from lxy_order o left join lxy_product p on p.id = o.product_id left join lxy_user s on s.id = o.sell_uid left join lxy_user b on b.id = o.buy_uid where o.product_id = #{id} -- 同一商品理论上只有一单（一物一件），但加排序可让结果确定， -- 避免将来出现重复数据时「有时取到这一单、有时取到那一单」 order by o.id desc limit 1
